$comment: Inventory of secrets/tokens this project depends on, and when they expire. The secret-expiry-reminder workflow reads this weekly and opens a GitHub issue (label: secret-rotation) when an entry is within leadTimeDays of its expiry. After you rotate a secret, update its `expires` date here. Entries with `expires: null` are inventory-only and never trigger a reminder.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.type: Fine-grained GitHub PAT — Issues: read/write on brian-dlptest/dlptest.com
secrets.rotate: As brian-dlptest, regenerate a fine-grained PAT (Issues read/write on this repo only), then `wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN` on prod and `wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN --env staging`. Powers the /api/feedback issue creation.

secrets.name: NEWS_COMMIT_TOKEN
secrets.type: Fine-grained GitHub PAT — Contents: read/write on brian-dlptest/dlptest.com (reused from the former NEWS_PR_TOKEN)
secrets.rotate: As brian-dlptest, regenerate the fine-grained PAT (Contents read/write on this repo only), then `wrangler secret put NEWS_COMMIT_TOKEN` on prod. Powers /api/news/publish committing posts to main+staging; it bypasses the protect-main ruleset via that ruleset's Repository-admin bypass.

secrets.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.type: Entra app registration client secret (dlptest-contact-form, client 4bd340ae-846e-4bd5-a890-4537f36db6dd)
secrets.rotate: Entra → App registration dlptest-contact-form → Certificates & secrets → new client secret, then `wrangler secret put GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET` on prod and `--env staging`. If this lapses the contact form stops sending email.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.type: Cloudflare API token used by CI to deploy Workers (GitHub Actions secret)
secrets.rotate: If this token has an expiry set in the Cloudflare dashboard, fill in `expires` here so it gets tracked. Regenerate under Cloudflare → My Profile → API Tokens, then update the GitHub repo secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

secrets.name: CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN
secrets.type: Cloudflare API token — Account Analytics:Read + Zone Analytics:Read (dlptest.com), for the /admin/traffic dashboard
secrets.rotate: Cloudflare → My Profile → API Tokens → regenerate a token with Account Analytics:Read and Zone → Analytics:Read scoped to dlptest.com, then `npx wrangler secret put CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` on prod and `CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npx wrangler secret put CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN --env staging`. If it lapses, /admin/traffic shows an 'analytics not configured' notice.

secrets.name: CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.type: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for the feedback form CAPTCHA
secrets.rotate: Turnstile keys don't expire. Only rotate if compromised: Cloudflare → Turnstile → the dlptest.com widget → Rotate secret key, then `wrangler secret put CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` on prod and `--env staging`.
